response.query: Which staggered DiD/event-study estimators will we implement (e.g., Callaway & Sant’Anna, Sun & Abraham), and under what conditions might TWFE be acceptable with corrections?
response.answer: We will implement Callaway & Sant’Anna and Sun & Abraham staggered DiD estimators. TWFE may be acceptable with corrections for parallel trends.
